description: Vikix office: the house rules for Codex CLI. vikix agents hooks codex --install links this to ~/.codex/hooks.json; vikix agent trusts it for you in your projects (--dangerously-bypass-hook-trust), elsewhere Codex asks once in /hooks. PreToolUse: an edit (apply_patch, read for every file it names) or a command judged by the house rules, a paused desk held, the notes left for the agent delivered; PermissionRequest: a step out of its sandbox that would write into the project's own folder, ~/vikix, another desk or ~/.config/vikix/secrets/ denied, whatever the mode; UserPromptSubmit: a turn begun, noted; Stop: a worker asked once for its handoff; SessionEnd: how it left, noted. The shapes are from Codex's hooks documentation (0.160, 2026-10-10).
